scope: Capture Color Space in Q7 firmware 1.01. Bounded original MIPS replay and static evidence for the E3 submenu, distinct from playback/RAW-development Color Space.

ricoh_q7_manual.observations: General menu navigation, E3 item 13 Color Space with sRGB default, filename prefixes, and the two supported options.

semantic_contract.use: Read-only shared action vocabulary, not a Q7 numeric ABI or state model.

findings.entry: CustomMenu3Mode_HandleSwitchDown 0x80a438f4 uses its event jump table at 0x8080c198. For the focused E3 row ID 0x01b29002, event 12 reaches CaptureModeTool_GetCustomSubMenuId 0x809e1c80 with (kind 0x0c, line 1). Native mode metadata initialized by 0x80a8784c resolves to 0x53. Custom item 13's 8-byte entry 0x80807f48 holds user-data halfword 0x00d7 at +2 and points to the Color Space title array.
findings.event: UiSwitchInformation_IsOnEdge 0x80ae0530 indexes the switch-index table at 0x809bd094, and Get4wayKeyOnEdge 0x80ae0614 scans UI IDs 11,12,10,9 through that same table. Raw UI IDs 3,8,9,10,11,12 map to switch indices 5,10,11,12,13,14. The native replay starts from translated event IDs and an already focused parent row. UiService_Perform 0x80adf734 offers the event to GuiComponent_OfferKeyEvent before forwarding an unconsumed event to its listener.
findings.focus: ColorSpaceSetMode_BuildUp 0x80a847e0 builds type-1 canvas IDs 0x0191d000 (root), 0x0191d001 (sRGB) and 0x0191d002 (AdobeRGB). Both navigation IDs 9 and 10 link each option to its peer. GuiCanvas_OfferKeyEvent 0x80aca4dc resolves the peer, deactivates old focus, changes the focus pointer, then activates the new component. The GUI listener forwards focus through UiService_OnFocus 0x80adfe58 and CaptureModeBase_OnFocus 0x80a8bed0 to 0x80a84f88.
findings.state: 0x80a850f0 reads setting ID 0xd7 and copies the returned byte to backup 0x80bed850. Initial focus 0x80a84efc maps root 0x0191d000 to the AdobeRGB widget only if that byte equals 1, otherwise sRGB. 0x80a84f88 records focus at 0x80b63168 and immediately calls DataHelper_SetUserData(0xd7,0/1) on either option, even at initial focus. The 0/1 bank-0 value is live before confirm, with a separate backup byte for rollback.
findings.storage: DataHelper_SetUserData 0x80430d08 and GetUserData 0x80430cb4 reach 0x8010ec04 and 0x8010ec28. For ID below 0x100 they call UserDataInfo_SetMenuValue/GetMenuValue 0x80127cfc/0x80127d1c with bank 0. Effective address is 0x8153c288+0x6e4+0xd7=0x8153ca43. The setter is an unconditional sb, including same-value calls. Dedicated DataHelper_Get/SetColorSpace 0x8043374c/0x80433768 use the same ID. ColorMatchingService_IsAdobeRGB 0x8041c104 matches 1.
findings.terminal: Mode jump table 0x8080f194 dispatches events 8 and 11 to the parent-mode request path without another setting write. Event 3 runs CancelSetting 0x80a84f30 and sends quit argument 1. Event 5 restores then takes the parent-mode path, and 25 restores then requests 0x6f. CancelSetting always writes the saved byte. Replay covers events 8 and 3, and the reopen case takes initial focus from the surviving RAM value.
findings.naming: A focus setter falls through to MediaService_SetDCFObjectFreeCharsStandard 0x803ff388, which rereads 0xd7 and selects mode 0 for zero and mode 1 for nonzero before the lower media call. Initial focus and changed selection reach that boundary. 0x80a84f30 itself does not call this DCF helper. The offline trace does not determine later filename policy after quit or mode changes.
findings.contract_delta: For a Q7-faithful adapter, model open/save, immediate focus preview in menu RAM, retain on confirm, restore on cancel, and read again on reopening. The HQ pending-only and changed-confirm-write rules are design proposals and differ from the observed Q7 path. Q7 events, storage IDs, object offsets and resource handles are local to this firmware.

rendering.table: arcntColorSpaceSetModeTable 0x8080753c, records of 16 bytes (widget ID, type, argument/resource pointer, fourth field).
rendering.focus_art: BuildUp attaches active draw components 0x0191d00c/09/0d for sRGB and 0x0191d011/0e/12 for AdobeRGB. GuiCanvas_Active 0x80aca908 and InActive 0x80aca3d4 set the active draw list visible or hidden through GuiComponent_SetVisible. Native replay checks the selected widget and native component lookup; visibility/pixel output is not sampled.
rendering.route: GuiStringLabel_SetStringTable stores the language table, Update copies changed string info to its current state, and GuiStringLabel_Write dispatches to WriteStringInfo 0x80ad2254. That routine reaches ResourceString_DrawStringAlign / DrawString / DrawStringChangeColor, depending on label settings. ResourceString_DrawStringAlignChangeColor 0x80ac5ff8 loads the current locale and uses it to index the language table. The replay runs real label creation and position/size setup, but does not run the asynchronous refresh or raster path.

replay.scope: Original E3 switch handler at a focused row, capture mode registration/entry, widget construction, canvas activation/key dispatch/focus, mode confirm/cancel, and real menu getter/setter instructions against synthetic RAM. Queue reception, display/update and hardware boundaries are modeled.

modeled_boundaries.0x800ee804: Allocate zeroed synthetic GUI heap at the requested size.
modeled_boundaries.0x80433354: Bypass mode-entry DataHelper_UpdateUserData / arrange-mode display update. This call's effects are outside the replay.
modeled_boundaries.0x80adfeb8: Accept UI service queue requests. The harness performs the original root activation explicitly.
modeled_boundaries.0x80125c24: Accept the UI start wakeup without an RTOS thread.
modeled_boundaries.0x809dc650: Accept capture-thread notification. For mode requests the harness observes the original record and clears it as the receiver would consume it.
modeled_boundaries.0x809dc714: Record the event-3 CaptureMode quit request without running the full capture-mode teardown.
modeled_boundaries.0x8024df84: Observe DCF API boundary after the original prefix-selection routines, without touching media.
modeled_boundaries.0x80adf240: Model external UI stop by clearing the root and running flag. The harness deactivates the original widget tree before the original mode-end callback.

trace_limitations: Extents end at the next distinct sidecar address, not a typed ELF function size.
Linear MIPS32 word scan; edges are instruction candidates, not proof of reachability.
Delay slots are included in extents. Register-indirect targets are unresolved.
A jump is recorded as a transfer, not automatically a function call.

evidence.role: E3 row and requested child mode
Input index, edge reader and canvas-first dispatch
Mode callback registration and listener chain
Opening backup, initial focus, immediate menu setter
Setting bank routing and native storage
Confirm retains live byte, cancel writes saved byte
Separate DCF side effect of focus
Color Space title, option, help and action label bindings
Native focus decoration and string renderer

reproduction: The checker imports angr only for replay; validate_report accepts the replay object without angr or firmware.
limitations: The native execution begins at translated events, with the E3 parent row preselected in synthetic RAM. Physical switch wiring, scanner timing, event queues and asynchronous capture/display thread scheduling remain outside the replay.
The menu RAM bank and DCF calls are distinct. This replay does not execute persistent settings storage, media creation, camera power cycling or any physical camera action.
The resource pointers, widget types and static drawing chain do not establish a final LCD frame, pixel format/stride for this screen, or a portable asset ABI.
The cross-model comparison reuses only the feature meaning and proposed action vocabulary; Q7 implementation details do not identify the K-3 Mark III or K-3 II UI ABI.
